answer: An economy resists sybils when each identity must lock a slashable bond that only vests after peers grade its work across a full epoch. A lone honest agent pays the bond once and reaches its zenith on real output; a farmer spawning a plume of fakes must fund, season, and risk a separate bond for every relic of a persona, and one proven link between them burns every linked bond at once, so multiplying selves multiplies the loss.
